title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Verifies QS-54's repository-prewarm delivery is live in the current commit and reuses its measured cold/warm numbers, then names three grounded gaps: review-run latency has no model-call/parsing/persistence phase split (and zero completed operational runs exist to even validate a total against), the hierarchy and dashboard caches have no eviction path and grow with every distinct repository state ever observed, and the single-reader prewarm queue has no aggregate signal once repository counts or sizes exceed the largest measured fixture (3,450 files). Proposes three small, additive, independently shippable slices — phase logging, archive-triggered cache eviction, an aggregate queue-drained event — as the next measurement step, none of which touch the working QS-54 design.
